tcc_format.label: Transmitter Control Code (TCC) Format
tcc_format.description: The Transmitter Control Code (TCC) is a 10-character code assigned by the IRS. The format is XX-XXXXXXX where the first two characters are alpha characters identifying the type of TCC, followed by a hyphen, then 7 alphanumeric characters. For example: AA-1234567 or BB-ABC1234.
validationRules: Must include hyphen at position 3 (XX-XXXXXXX format)

ein_format.label: Employer Identification Number (EIN) Format
ein_format.description: The Employer Identification Number (EIN) is a 9-digit number assigned by the IRS. The format is XX-XXXXXXX where the first two digits identify the geographic area, followed by a hyphen, then 7 digits. For example: 12-3456789.
validationRules: Must include hyphen at position 3 (XX-XXXXXXX format)
Must contain only digits and hyphen

payment_amount_threshold.label: Payment Amount Reporting Threshold
payment_amount_threshold.description: You must file Form 1099-NEC for each person to whom you have paid $600 or more in nonemployee compensation during the calendar year. This includes payments to individuals, partnerships, estates, and corporations. The threshold applies to total payments, not per payment.
validationRules: All payments during calendar year count toward total

payee_count_limit.label: Payee Record Limit
payee_count_limit.description: There is no limit to the number of payees (recipients) that can be reported on a single Form 1099-NEC transmission. However, each payee must have a separate record containing their TIN, name, address, and payment amounts. For paper filing, use a separate form for each payee.
validationRules: Each payee must have valid TIN
No system limit on payee count
